title: Transboundary haze outlook and regional measures
asked: Mr Christopher de Souza asked for the latest assessment of transboundary haze affecting Singapore, and whether bilateral and regional measures to mitigate haze are being reviewed and strengthened.
response: The Meteorological Service Singapore assesses that hotspot activity could increase in the coming weeks because of wind patterns and drier conditions in the northeast monsoon's dry phase, and cloud seeding would not be effective given Singapore's size and geography. Regional and bilateral cooperation is therefore essential, carried out through the ASEAN Specialised Meteorological Centre in Singapore, the ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution and the Ministerial Steering Committee on Transboundary Haze Pollution. Singapore's 24-hour PSI readings have stayed in the good to moderate range this year, peaking at 69 on 8 February, which the Minister said is below the level warranting investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act. If conditions worsen, the Haze Task Force of 28 Government agencies will issue advisories, ensure N95 mask supply and deploy indoor air purifiers in schools, public hospitals, nursing homes and polyclinics.

key_points.point: Hotspot activity could rise in the coming weeks due to wind patterns and drier conditions in the northeast monsoon's dry phase, which could bring hazy conditions to Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: hotspot activity could increase in the coming weeks over nearby areas due to wind patterns and drier conditions in the current dry phase of the northeast monsoon

key_points.point: Cloud seeding for rain would not work for Singapore because of its size and geography, and induced rain might not fall on Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Cloud seeding for rain will not be effective, given our size and geography.

key_points.point: Singapore engages neighbours through the ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution and the Ministerial Steering Committee on Transboundary Haze Pollution, and supports Indonesia's move to operationalise the ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Transboundary Haze Pollution Control.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We strongly support Indonesia's efforts to operationalise the ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Transboundary Haze Pollution Control, to be based in Indonesia.

key_points.point: 24-hour PSI readings stayed in the good to moderate range this year, with a peak of 69 on 8 February.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Our 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) readings have remained in the "good" to "moderate" range this year, with a peak PSI reading of 69 on 8 February

key_points.point: At this stage the haze has not reached levels that warrant investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: the haze has not reached such levels that warrant investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act

key_points.point: The Haze Task Force, led by NEA and made up of 28 Government agencies, will issue advisories, ensure sufficient N95 masks and deploy indoor air purifiers in schools, public hospitals, nursing homes and polyclinics.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Indoor air purifiers will also be deployed in premises where vulnerable groups are likely to congregate, such as schools, public hospitals, nursing homes and polyclinics.

key_points.point: Four companies are currently under investigation under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: we have an investigation that is open at this moment, with four companies under investigation

key_points.point: Financial assistance from Singapore has not been discussed at ASEAN level, as the Minister said neighbours are not seeking it.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: the issue of finance has not arisen, because I do not think our neighbours are looking for financial assistance

left_open: The specific PSI threshold at which N95 mask distribution and haze sanctuaries would be activated
Whether the bilateral and regional measures are being formally reviewed and strengthened
Whether any prosecution has been brought under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act in its 12-year history
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered investigations and prosecutions under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, financial assistance to neighbours, and thresholds for activating haze measures.
